author: The Current
description:
Watch Brigitte Calls Me Baby performing "These Acts of Which We're Designed" off the album, "Irreversible"
Support The Current: https://support.mpr.org/youtube or hit the Thanks button

It’s been a busy year for Brigitte Calls Me Baby. They released the album, "Irreversible," back on March 13, and since that time, they’ve released a string of singles, including “Altitude,” “Geordie,” “I Can Take the Sun Out of the Sky” and “Slumber Party” — all while busily touring in North America and Europe.

Brigitte Calls Me Baby’s Devin Wessels has a simple and reasonable explanation for the band’s prolific output: “We can’t stop writing,” he says.

As their most recent North American tour leg led them to First Avenue in Minneapolis for a show on November 7, Brigitte Calls Me Baby visited The Current studio for a session hosted by Jill Riley. Watch their performance of "These Acts of Which We're Designed," above.

Watch and listen to the full session: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=YMCRYJ5jaL8
title: Brigitte Calls Me Baby perform "These Acts of Which We're Designed" at The Current
